run_rattle_test: run the main function to test that ASE rattle respects FixAtoms constraints on a Cu slab
build_fcc_slab: build an FCC(100) copper slab using ase.build.fcc100 with a specified size tuple
create_molecule: create a CO molecule using ase.build.molecule for use as an adsorbate on a slab
add_adsorbate_to_slab: add an adsorbate molecule to a slab surface using ase.build.add_adsorbate with an offset
test_rattle_constraints: test that rattling atoms with a FixAtoms constraint leaves fixed atoms unchanged
